test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: Potassium is more reactive than gold.
All metals are not equally reactive.
Silver is less reactive than sodium.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**All metals are equally reactive**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Not all metals have the same level of **reactivity**. Metals differ in their ability to react with other substances.
